title: UX / Service Designer
profile: UX and Service Designer with 2 years of industry experience and an MSc in Design Innovation from Maynooth University, grounded in user-centred and service design thinking. Experienced across the full arc of a problem: discovery through user research and stakeholder interviews, mapping user journeys and friction points, then designing user flows, wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity UI in Figma. Strong at working closely with stakeholders, users and development teams, and at communicating research findings clearly in written case studies.
